Good progress — the ✈️ is gone. But now we can see three separate things blocking picture messages, and we need to fix all of them:

**1. Mobile data is turned off (📵 Data Disabled).** MMS requires mobile data — that's why the messaging app says it can't send MMS.

**2. The network is on 2G.** 2G is too slow to carry picture messages; they need 3G, 4G, or 5G.

**3. Signal is only 1 bar / "Poor."** Part of that poor signal may just be because the phone dropped to 2G; improving the network mode should help.

Let's fix them one at a time.

**Next thing to check — your APN settings (specifically the MMSC URL).**

The APN is the set of network settings your phone uses to reach the carrier. Picture messaging depends on one specific part of it called the **MMSC URL** — the server that actually handles MMS. If that's blank or wrong, calls, texts, and web browsing all still work fine, but pictures will never send. That matches your symptoms exactly.

Here's what to do:
